notes.title: Silent Stay – My New Psychological Horror Game Is Now on Steam
notes.content:
[p][b]🎉 My next game [i]Silent Stay[/i] is now live on Steam – Wishlist now![/b][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I’m excited to announce my upcoming game: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820020/Silent_Stay/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]After releasing [i]Room Service[/i], I took your feedback to heart – and [i]Silent Stay[/i] is built with all of that in mind:[/p][p]🔹 [b]Larger production budget[/b]
🔹 [b]Fully voiced by real voice actors[/b]
🔹 [b]Significant improvements based on the criticism of Room Service[/b][/p][p][/p][p]If [i]Room Service[/i] caught your interest, [i]Silent Stay[/i] will go further – and I’d love your support. Wishlisting helps tremendously with visibility on Steam and keeps the project moving forward.[/p][p]Thanks for being part of this journey 🙏
– Zictorix[/p]
